name: Eek! The Cat
description: Koombaya, it's Eek the cat and all his friends. Annabelle, Eek's 800-pound girlfriend, Sharky the vicious but lovable sharkdog, and Elmo the elk. Plus you can watch the Terrible Thunderlizards try to make Bill and Scooter, the cavemen, extinct. Plus there's Klutter who's, well, we're not exactly sure what Klutter is, but watch and find out for yourself.

videos.title: MiserEek
videos.overview: Eek feels unappreciated and runs away from home. He winds up living with a sweet old lady, who nearly gets him killed when she takes him to the zoo rather than the vet.

videos.title: Bearz 'n the Hood
videos.overview: Eek goes to the mall to get Wendy Elizabeth an autograph from her favorite TV stars, the Squishy Bearz. Unfortunately, Eek and the Squishy Bearz become fugitives after a rat gang dress up like the Bearz as part of a plot to ransom off the mayor's statue.

videos.title: Catsanova
videos.overview: Eek falls in love with Annabelle, a 200 pound cat that just moved into the neighborhood. However, a deadly shark dog (Sharky) lives with her and won't let Eek anywhere near her. Eek will need some help from a nerdy, one winged Cupid, who will get his other wing if Eek kisses Annabelle.

videos.title: Eek vs. the Flying Saucers
videos.overview: Eek sneaks onto a space capsule to pursue an alien that abducted Annabelle.

videos.title: Cape Fur
videos.overview: Eek regrets saving a cute little pink bunny from a storm when he learns the bunny is really a large, tattooed psychopath. Worst of all, this bunny is planning to do away with the family.

videos.title: HallowEek
videos.overview: Eek goes trick or treating with J.B. and Wendy Elizabeth, but eventually gets seperated. He then meets Cryptie, a ghost that got seperated from his family as well. While they try to find them, they are unknown their loved ones have fallen into the clutches of a beautiful and evil witch.

videos.title: Eek's International Adventure
videos.overview: While on a trip to Uncle Vic's potato ranch with Mom and the kids, Eek finds himself mistaken for a secret agent by Sasha, a beautiful enemy spy falling in love with him. She leads him to the vengeful and disembodied villain, the Brain.

videos.title: HawaiiEek 5-0
videos.overview: Annabelle falls in her swimming pool so Eek calls in the famous undersea explorer Jacques L'Duck to save her, but their underwater submersible is attacked by Sharky. Annabelle, Eek and Jacques are sucked down the plughole and emerge on a tropical island populated by natives who make Annabelle their queen. However, when they prepare to sacrifice her, Eek comes to her rescue.

videos.title: Great Balls of Fur!
videos.overview: Rock'n roll legend and cat food pitchman Melvis fakes his death, so his manager cons Eek into impersonating him.

videos.title: The Whining Pirates of Tortuga
videos.overview: Eek tells the neighborhood kittens an adventurous tale of when he was a kitten and helping a crew of pirates find treasure.

videos.title: The Eekcidental Tourist
videos.overview: Wendy Elizabeth's geography grades need improving, so Mom takes the kids and Eek on a cross-country trip to learn about America. Eek, however, gets left behind at the first stop and has to run across the country to rejoin them.

videos.title: It's a Wonderful Nine Lives
videos.overview: Eek finds a package dropped from Santa's sleigh and makes sure to get it to it's destination, while spreading holiday cheer along the way.

videos.title: The Eeksterminator
videos.overview: Eek has a birthday present for Wendy Elizabeth: a Squishy Bearz inflatable termite farm. But the glass breaks and two spiders threaten the defenseless termites. The only one to escape, Termee, goes to Eek for help.

videos.title: Shark Therapy
videos.overview: Sharky gets hurt in an accident involving Eek, who makes sure Sharky receives the proper care during his recovery.

videos.title: Speed FrEek
videos.overview: Eek and Annabelle are going to see Elmo race Dakota the Terribly Dysfunctional Turtle at the speedway. But Dakota is disqualified and Elmo chickens out in the face of a new contender. He then cons Eek into racing.

videos.title: Rocketship to Jupiter
videos.overview: Eek gets hit on the head and finds himself in the land of Toodlesnook, saving the Bearz from various dangers.

videos.title: Eek's Funny Thing That He Does
videos.overview: J.B. and Wendy Elizabeth sell lemonade to get the money to buy a Sladamese language-o-matic tape for Mom. Eek, however, lets a mouse drink the lemonade and needs to get more lemons. Unfortunately, the only lemon tree is next to Sharky, who is watching his favorite show, Patriotic Warriors.

videos.title: Eekpocalypse Now!
videos.overview: Eek journeys up the McTropolis River to find Sharky, who has become the leader of a gang of dogs.

videos.title: Eex Men
videos.overview: Eek gets left with a magical cape and takes over for a super hero, battling the evil Garbage Man and his henchmen.

videos.title: Quadrapedia
videos.overview: Two witch cats, jealous of Annabelle's looks, kidnap her.

videos.title: Night on Squishy Mountain
videos.overview: Eek and the family are at the Squishy Bear Amusement park. While the kids get separated, Mom meets a crazed automaton of Hoyte Gunterkrust, creator of the Squishy Bearz.

videos.title: Star TrEek
videos.overview: Captain Eek of the Starship Shoesuntied and his crew enter the Sharktarian Galaxy. Eek and his crew mates, Mr. Sock and Mittens, are captured by Sharky, leader of the Sharktarians.

videos.title: Eeking Out a Living
videos.overview: After accidently damaging Anabelle's new water fountain, Eek and Sharky go to Elmo's Employment agency to get jobs to pay for the glue.

videos.title: Meat the Thunderlizards
videos.overview: The Terrible Thunderlizards are released from jail to destroy the greatest threat to Jurassic City and dinosaur existence: two humans named Bill and Scooter.

videos.title: The Great Eekscape
videos.overview: Eek has lost his and Sharky's licenses and they go to the pound. They try to find a way to escape.

videos.title: The Lava My Life
videos.overview: The Thuggasaurs kidnap the President's daughter. But their plan doesn't quite work out when the cross pathes with Bill, Scooter and the Thunderlizards.

videos.title: Eek Goes to the Hot Spot
videos.overview: Eek gets killed after being run over by a truck. Another dead cat tricks him and Eek winds up going to hell, where he contends with it's ruler, Fido.

videos.title: Tar and Away
videos.overview: Bill and Scooter discover tar, save a couple alien chairs from Thuggasaurs and wind up disintegrating some of Jurassic City.

videos.title: It's a Very Merry Eek's-mas
videos.overview: Eek discovers Sharky is depressed because he misses his family. Eek goes to Santa Claus himself to see Sharky's Christmas wish granted. But Santa's reindeer have gone on strike, so Eek and Sharky have to help deliver the Christmas presents.

videos.title: Always Eat Your Spinach
videos.overview: The Thunderlizards find Bill and Scooter hiding in a dinosaur suburban home. They disguise themselves as exterminators to get into the house and destroy the humans.

videos.title: All About Babs
videos.overview: The Dino Scientists have created something they think will surely help destroy the humans: Babs, the first human female. They place a homing device in her purse to lead them to Scooter and Bill, who becomes the first human to ever to get dumped.

videos.title: The Frying Game
videos.overview: Bill and Scooter are in the desert and dying of thirst. As the Thunderlizards pursue, they stumble upon Thuggasaurs planning to fire a missile into Jurassic City.

videos.title: Ice Age Kapades
videos.overview: When an experimental Ice Weapon falls into Bill and Scooter's hands, they accidentally set off the Ice Age.

videos.title: Something's Abyss
videos.overview: Scooter invents bungy jumping, which sends Bill falling into Doomsday Cavern. While the Thunderlizards pursue, Bill and Scooter are captured by the cavern's inhabitants and face painful torture, until Bill finds himself set to marry the princess of the subterranean slimey slugs.

videos.title: The Unbearable Lightness of Being Scooter
videos.overview: The Thunderlizards are issued Flechette, a pittosaur to track down the humans. They accidentally find the Thuggasaurs planning to attack Jurassic City with bee bombs from a disguised inflatable dirigible.

videos.title: Thundersaurus Wrecks
videos.overview: Scooter saves a young bat falling out of a tree. The grateful mother then helps Bill and Scooter escape the Thunderlizards, who pursue them in a pterodon-shaped fighter.

videos.title: A Sharkwork Orange
videos.overview: With Sharky out of control, Eek takes him to Dr. Elmo's clinic for some therapy.

videos.title: Let's Make a Wheel
videos.overview: Bill goes for a ride on Scooter's wheel, causing him to crash into the Thunderlizards's camp and wreak havoc with the Beehive Super Cannon.

videos.title: T-Rex, Lies and Videotape
videos.overview: The Thunderlizards are using video cameras to track the humans, but they have to stop Thuggasaurs from releasing exploding flowers on Jurassic City. Meanwhile, Bill and Scooter discover the cameras and invent the sitcom.

videos.title: Mountain Groan
videos.overview: Eek, Anabelle, Elmo and the Squishy Bearz go camping, where they come across Bigfoot and a mysterious kidnapper.

videos.title: Paws
videos.overview: Annabelle's goldfish Bruce accidentally eats to much and grows large enough to terrorize the wading pool.

videos.title: In the Line of Fur
videos.overview: The Secret Service draft Eek and assign him to protect Socks, the White House cat, during an appearance at a hospital.

videos.title: Chariots of Fur
videos.overview: Eek is conned into running in a marathon by Elmo, which will help get Elmo's little brother Timmy another needed operation.

videos.title: Honey I Shrunk the Cat
videos.overview: Eek and Sharky are shrunk by Dr. Elmo's new device and go on a mission to the President's brain to remove a raisin.

videos.title: Shark Doggy Dog
videos.overview: Sharky is discovered by Don Cornelius of the hit TV show Soul Choo-choo while choking on a mailman's sock. Sharky and Eek get a record deal and the expected chaos results.

videos.title: Fatal Eektraction
videos.overview: A dog named Alice moves in next door and becomes preoccupied with Eek. So much so that she vows to get rid of Annabelle.

videos.title: The Good, the Bad and the Squishy
videos.overview: In spoof of old Westerns, Eek and the Dog with No Name (Sharky) must save the town of Hayfever from the Bandito Bearz.

videos.title: Birth of a Notion
videos.overview: Scooter is busy working on a birthday surprise for Bill when Babs shows up and has them build her a shopping mall. When the Thunderlizards arrive, they encounter the malls security systems.

videos.title: Eek's SnEek PEek
videos.overview: Eek takes viewers on a behind-the-scenes tour of the show's production.

videos.title: The Thunder Years
videos.overview: While waiting to be rescued from a cave, the Thunderlizards recall their childhood.

videos.title: The EeX Files
videos.overview: The family is flying to see Uncle Vic when Eek falls out of the airplane. He falls into Area 51, seeing secret government testing and meeting a nice alien that wants to escape.

videos.title: The Hurting Show
videos.overview: Scooter sets up a talk show so Bill can deal with his pain with the creatures who've hurt him. Meanwhile, the Thunderlizards foil a Thuggasaur plot to kidnap Mrs. Galapagos.

videos.title: Paw Sores
videos.overview: After Sharky drops a piano on his head, Eek dreams he has to save the universe from the infamous Dark Lawyer.

videos.title: T-Rex and Sympathy
videos.overview: Mr. T-Rex is accompanying the Thunderlizards on their mission, while Bill and Scooter start growing plants in their "garden of eatin'". Mr. T-Rex proves to be not very effective as a leader and gets caught by a huge venus flytrap.

videos.title: The Eeksorcist
videos.overview: Sharky is possessed by a Huggie, becoming more and more cute. Eek and Dr. Elmo must to rid Sharky of this cuteness before it is too late.

videos.title: Boo Thunder
videos.overview: Scooter invents ""Hollow-weed"" (Halloween). Meanwhile, the Thunderlizards battle to stop the Thuggasaurs' lava-covered robot from destroying Jurassic City.

videos.title: Lord of the Fleas
videos.overview: Eek offers to look after Elmo's Penguins, but winds up fighting with Sharky for control when they all get locked in a shopping mall.

videos.title: Postcards from the X-Zone
videos.overview: Bill and Scooter go on vacation after the Thunderlizards drop a Stink Bomb on their home. Meanwhile, the Thunderlizards foil a plan by the Thuggosaurs to release giggle gas from a float during the Fossil Day Festival and Parade in Jurassic City.

videos.title: Eekstremely Dull
videos.overview: The Squirrel family moves into the tree in Eek's yard.

videos.title: Planet of the Crepes
videos.overview: Taylor of Planet of the Apes crash lands into the time of dinosaurs and runs into Bill and Scooter. Meanwhile, the Thunderlizards discover the Thuggasaurs trying to use a sub-launched missile to destroy Jurassic City.

videos.title: Eeksy Rider
videos.overview: Eek works to get Wendy Elizabeth a new bicycle bell.

videos.title: A Sharkdog Day Afternoon
videos.overview: A robot dog catcher comes from the future to dispose of Sharky. Eek and a female dog from the future have to protect him.

videos.title: Rebel Without the Claws
videos.overview: Eek and Sharky work together to help Annabelle with her lack of suntan lotion.

videos.title: Cromagnon Farce
videos.overview: Babs trades Scooter a 'magic twig' for a winter supply of food. Meanwhile, the Thunderlizards test Dr. Steggy's photon laser cannon to destroy the humans while in orbit. But the Thuggasaurs sneak onto the shuttle, plotting to use the cannon on Jurassic City.

videos.title: This Eek's Your Life
videos.overview: With several flashbacks, Sharky's friends and family honor him

videos.title: Try Hard
videos.overview: After Eek accidentally destroys his Plantinum icesculputer, Sharky wants calls in a gang of international hit-sharkdogs to get rid of Eek once and for all.

videos.title: Valley of the Dogs
videos.overview: Sharky leaves home to become a broadway star.

videos.title: Klutter
videos.overview: Wade and Ryan want a pet and it has to be something their father isn't allergic to. A static electricity discharge takes care of that, bringing Klutter (made up of clothes and junk) to life.

videos.title: Pup Fiction
videos.overview: Sharky takes the lead role in a spoof of the movie, Pulp Fiction.

videos.title: The Klutter and I (Infection)
videos.overview: Wade and Ryan's friends spend the night at the house to watch a horror movie.

videos.title: Natural Bored Kittens
videos.overview: Eek tells three kittens stories of his youth, which include the inventions of his Scottish uncle.

videos.title: Lizard of Aaaahs
videos.overview: The Thuggasaurs plot a surprise attack on the Thunderlizards using Thuggasaur robots.

videos.title: OutbrEek
videos.overview: Eek, Elmo, Mittens and Sharky are quarantined together after an infestation of Sharktarian fleas.

videos.title: Arctic Blast
videos.overview: Bill and Scooter have made it to the arctic, where the Thunderlizards try to destroy them using the Aurora Borealis missile.

videos.title: Octopussy Cat
videos.overview: Eek tries to get a octopus back to the ocean.

videos.title: Mixed Klutter
videos.overview: Mrs. Heap invites Kopp and Vanna on a family visit to the aquarium where Klutter goes missing.

videos.title: Going to Eekstremes
videos.overview: Eek's cousin from Milwaukee, Cat, gets Eek to participate in some extreme sports.

videos.title: Bi-Pedator
videos.overview: General Galopagos has a tabloid reporter to put up with, while the Thunderlizards take up gardening.

videos.title: Dazed and Eekstremely Confuzed
videos.overview: Eek gets cast as the lead of John Landis' next film, which is about a watermelon getting crushed by stampeding elephants.

videos.title: Franken-Klutter
videos.overview: While at a science fair, Klutter gets kidnapped by a mad scientist.

videos.title: Eek Space 9
videos.overview: In the further adventures of Captain Eek and the Starship Shoesuntied, a crazed commander plots to destroy the universe to end those politically correct storylines.

videos.title: The Yawn of Man
videos.overview: Babs boasts about her new home to Bill and Scooter. Meanwhile, the Thuggasaurs ready a de-aging weapon to be unleashed on Jurassic City.

videos.title: The GraduEek
videos.overview: Sharky meets a mail carrier trainee and falls in love.

videos.title: Peanut, Klutter, and Jelly
videos.overview: Klutter and the kids try to return a lost turtle to it's home.

videos.title: PolitEekly Correct
videos.overview: Eek and Sharky take a quail to the birth places of various music.

videos.title: Whatta Woild
videos.overview: The Thunderlizards become trapped on a Thuggasaur submarine and have to stop them from sinking the President's boat.

videos.title: Night of the Living Spuds
videos.overview: Klutter and the kids discover mutant potatoes bent on world domination.

videos.title: Goop Dreams
videos.overview: Scooter tries inventing sports. Meanwhile, the Thunderlizards get a new weapon, sticky goop, to catch the humans.

videos.title: It's a Thunderful Life
videos.overview: The Thunderlizards' new weapon causes more trouble for Jurassic City than for Bill and Scooter.

videos.title: Thunder & Frightning
videos.overview: The Thunderlizards have trouble with their rocket packs and have to stop the Thuggasaurs from burrowing under Jurassic City.

videos.title: The Ghost of Goober Bottom Pond
videos.overview: Klutter and the kids investigate stories of a ghost.

videos.title: The Thunder of it All
videos.overview: While in pursuit of Bill and Scooter, the Thunderlizards stumble onto yet another Thuggasaur plan to attack Jurassic City.

videos.title: Bonfire of the Vanna-Tea
videos.overview: Klutter ruins Vanna's high society party.

videos.title: The Magnificent 5½
videos.overview: The Thunderlizards, Mr. T-Rex, Nate the Dragon and El Gordo must work together to stop the Thuggasaurs from launching an attack.

videos.title: DiabolEek
videos.overview: Sharky is plagued by nightmares involving Eek and seeks professional help in the form of Dr. Elmo.

videos.title: Pre-hysteric Man
videos.overview: Bill proclaims dominance over nature, until the wild life decides to strike back. This leads to lava flowing towards Jurassic City and the Thunderlizards must save the day.

videos.title: Molten Rock-n-Roll
videos.overview: A helicopter with heavy metal idol Dee Snidersaur on board crashes in the X-Zone and into the clutches of the Thuggasaurs. The Thunderlizards go to save him.

videos.title: MystEek Pizza
videos.overview: Eek gets blasted up into space after ruining one of Sharky's favorite shows.

videos.title: Eek Bin Ein Berliner
videos.overview: A series of vignettes is created when Eek once again causes the destruction of Sharky's dog house.

videos.title: Thunder Valley
videos.overview: Bill takes up Scooter's advice and tries to lose some weight. Meanwhile, the Thunderlizards' efforts are complicated by liquid helium.

videos.title: Snowbored
videos.overview: Elmo chickens out of a snowboard race and cons Eek into going in his place.

videos.title: Fists of Furry
videos.overview: With the help of Cynthia Raverock, Sharky starts training in martial arts.

videos.title: The Island of Dr. Meow
videos.overview: Eek tries to brighten Sharky's day, which again causes the destruction of his dog house. Trying to relax while flying a kite, Sharky winds up on a island where bizzare experiments are being performed.

videos.title: Home O'Sapien Alone
videos.overview: A demolition mixup means the Thunderlizards had better go hunt Bill and Scooter until General Galapagos calms down.

videos.title: Nightmare on Elmo St.
videos.overview: Eek offers to help Elmo bake for a cake sale to help Timmy who believes that he is a genie. However, Elmo inserts too much mixture into a microwavable chocolate soufflé and it comes alive, attacking them.

videos.title: Night of the Living Duds
videos.overview: The Thunderlizards head to the X-Zone to destroy a Thuggasaur cannon.

videos.title: Show Squirls
videos.overview: Eek helps the squirrels put on a show, which turns into a road show and Sharky becomes their manager.

videos.title: Eekscaliber
videos.overview: One sunny day, Eek leaves a chocolate bunny for Sharky, who slips and falls on the melted chocolate. After hitting his head, Sharky is transported back to the time of the Arthurian legends.

videos.title: The FugEektive
videos.overview: Sharky loses his memory and is accused of a bank robbery. With John Walsh's help, Eek tries to clear Sharky's name.

videos.title: The Sound of MusEek
videos.overview: Eek and friends host a benefit concert for Elmo's little brother Timmy.

videos.title: Oh... The Humanity
videos.overview: The Thunderlizards have to guard a valuable discovery.

videos.title: Rock-Eek 6
videos.overview: Sharky inadvertantly winds up injuring Platinum. He feels so guilty, he takes her place in a battle against Roboticus the Disturbed Android.

country: Canada, United States, South Korea, Taiwan
